conviction_note: Near-balanced: the company's H1 guide needs a record Q2 (operating profit 8.45bn yen, +33% on Q1) from a company that missed its own H1 plan in two of the last three years. Against that, the stock has already fallen 24% since 10-06 in a sector-wide AI-capex sell-off (it fell less than Fujikura, Ibiden and TEL), and the street's FY number sits on the company plan, so a held guide is a relief rather than a miss. p_up is 49 on a 7.5% scale. The findings sum (-0.2) and the scaled number (-0.15) agree because nothing decisive was found.
bar: Company H1 (Apr-Sep) guide raised 2026-07-29: sales 42,200m / OP 14,800m; FY sales 93,300m / OP 33,700m; dividend 55+55 (Q1 決算短信, https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/53440/081220260728501211_tse-qcedjpsm-53440-20260729353440-ixbrl.htm). Street: Yahoo earningsTrend Q2 EPS 462.17 / revenue 22.325bn (1 analyst), FY EPS 2,014.5 / revenue 93.52bn (5 analysts) (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v10/finance/quoteSummary/5344.T?modules=earningsTrend); IFIS FY ordinary-profit consensus 35,173m (down 3.5% w/w on 2026-08-26, https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTop?bcode=5344). The street sits on the company plan for FY and slightly below it for Q2 revenue (22.3bn against 22.9bn implied). print_vs_bar is H1 OP against the 14,800m guide.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 0.95% (prev 0.81%, +0.14pp, 1 seller) as of 2026-10-26 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, sealed baseline). Margin ratio (信用倍率) 23.91, a crowded leveraged-retail long: that is the setup in which a miss still finds sellers. No options or skew in Japan. Run-up: -15.17% over 20 sessions and -24% from the 10-06 close of 61,350, sector-wide. priced_lean_pct +0.36.

findings.finding: The H1 guide raised on 2026-07-29 (OP 14,800m) needs Q2 OP of 8,452m, a record quarter (prior record 7,852m in Jan-Mar 2026), +33% on Q1's 6,348m and +75% on Jul-Sep 2025. The FY guide of 33,700m then implies an H2 of 18,900m, about 9.45bn a quarter. MARUWA missed its own H1 plan in FY3/2024 (9,100m to 8,649m) and FY3/2026 (+0.1% guided, -15.2% delivered, with a FY cut at the Q2 print), and missed Yahoo's quarterly EPS consensus on each of the last four quarters (-20%, -4%, -18%, -12%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the Q2 print of 2025-11-05 (10:40), H1 OP missed and FY was cut 6.3%. The stock had already opened -6.5% and went -1.7% from the open to the next close (-8.1% from the prior close). On 2026-07-29 a 13.5% FY raise that came in below consensus fell -4.95% intraday and finished flat by the next close. On 2026-05-08 a new-year guide below consensus took -11.3% from the open to the next close.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-27 (page as fetched; quarterly table shows 26.04-06 announced 26/07/29)
findings.why_not_priced: The October fall matches the AI/semiconductor sector move (Fujikura -32%, Furukawa -37%, Ibiden -33%, TEL -29%, MARUWA -24% from 10-06 to 10-26), so it holds no company-specific discount for an H1 shortfall. If the market were pricing a miss, MARUWA would have lagged its peers rather than outperformed them. Partly priced: the single-analyst Q2 revenue estimate (22.3bn) already sits below the company-implied 22.9bn.
findings.independence: Second source for the guide numbers and the 2025-11-05 cut: kabutan articles https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=5344&b=k202607290003 and https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=5344&b=k202511050001 (the same company documents, so not independent evidence).

findings.finding: The stock went into the print 24% off its 10-06 close on a sector-wide AI-capex scare (kabutan 10-15: SOX -4%+ on a CoreWeave bond-price collapse; 10-19: AI over-investment worries). MARUWA fell less than its AI peers, and the street's FY number (Yahoo FY EPS 2,014.5, IFIS ordinary 35,173m) sits on the company plan of 33,700m OP plus roughly 1.2-1.3bn of non-operating income. So holding or nudging up the FY guide after a sector de-rating would be a relief print (悪材料出尽くし), not a disappointment against the street.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-02-03 a weak 3Q (cumulative OP -13%), released with a statement that next year would bring a full recovery, rose +9.4% on the day and +5.3% from the open to the next close. On 2024-10-29 (Q2, 10:40) the stock rose +11.2% from the open to the next close.
findings.why_not_priced: The sector sell-off is priced. What is not priced is whether MARUWA's own demand (info-telecom and semiconductor, the drivers named in the Q1 raise) held through a quarter the market has de-rated as a group. Peers' prints mostly land after this one. If the market expected the guide to hold, MARUWA would have tracked the 1306 TOPIX ETF (-5%) rather than its AI peers.
findings.independence: Peer moves computed from Yahoo daily closes (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/5803.T?range=2mo&interval=1d and same for 5801.T, 4062.T, 8035.T, 6857.T). Consensus from https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTop?bcode=5344 and Yahoo earningsTrend. Different sources from the kabutan news.

findings.finding: The yen strengthened from about 162.6 to 157.6 per dollar between the end of Q1 (June) and the end of Q2 (September); the Q2 average was about 159.3 against the company's 158 assumption. So operating profit gets no FX help, and the Q2 ordinary and net lines probably carry a valuation loss, as in Jul-Sep 2024 (ordinary 5,818m against OP 7,149m). The company itself says ordinary profit and below move mainly on FX, which is why it does not guide them.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2024-10-29, a Q2 print with ordinary profit well below OP rose +11.2% from the open to the next close, so the market looked through the non-operating line.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-27 (monthly averages: Jul 162.53, Aug 158.86, Sep 156.38; Sep close 157.56; Jun close 162.63)
findings.why_not_priced: Below operating income and not guided, so the single Q2 EPS estimate of 462 may not carry it. Sized at a fraction because the market trades this name on OP.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: possible both ways. The company revised at Q1 this year and at Q2 last year (a cut); the street's FY sits on the plan, so a hold is neutral to a relief. Returns: unlikely; the interim dividend of 55 is set and raises have come at FY prints. New-year guide: not applicable (H1 print). Quarter vs its own 進捗率: Q1 OP was 42.9% of the H1 guide against Q1/H1 actuals of about 51.5% in FY3/2025 and FY3/2026, and 18.8% of FY against 21-24% before. So the guide is unusually back-loaded and needs a record Q2.

baseline_tension: The run-up (-15% over 20 days) and the slightly positive lean (+0.36) point to relief, while the crowded margin long (23.9) and building shorts point the other way. My two main findings offset. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held or raised FY guide after a sector de-rating; I looked for it and filed it as finding 2. There is no buyback precedent and the interim dividend is set.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the last 短信): p_up moved from 48 to 49, so expected_move goes from -0.30 to -0.15. Finding 1's size is left at -0.6 because the draft had already shrunk it for the street sitting below the company-implied Q2.
Rule 2 (check the sign; look for the strongest positive): already done in the draft (finding 2, held guide after the sector de-rating; returns checked and none expected). Nothing changed.
